question: Which of the following reactions represents symbolic combination reaction?
solution:
The Correct answer is '**A + B → C'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A combination reaction is a reaction in which two or more substances combine to form a single new substance.
 
• Combination reactions can also be called **synthesis reactions.**
 
• The general form of a combination reaction is:
 
 
• **A + B → C.**
 
 
 
• Combination reaction is when two or more elements combine to form a compound.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• General forms of representation of different reactions are as follows:
 
• 
 
 
 

 **Reaction**
 **General formula**
 
 

 Combination Reaction
 A + B → C
 
 

 Decomposition Reaction
 AB → A + B
 
 

 Displacement Reaction
 AB + CD → AC + BD
 
 

 Displacement Reaction
 AB + C → AC + B
